definitions.explanation: A clinic that provides manual body adjustment and manipulation therapy to address musculoskeletal issues. Distinct from Western chiropractic, Japanese seitai encompasses various traditional and modern bodywork techniques.

examples.japanese: {腰|こし}が{痛|いた}いので{整体院|せいたいいん}に{行|い}く。
examples.english: My lower back hurts, so I'm going to a bodywork clinic.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{新|あたら}しい{整体院|せいたいいん}が{開業|かいぎょう}した。
examples.english: A new chiropractic clinic opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: {友人|ゆうじん}に{勧|すす}められた{整体院|せいたいいん}に{通|かよ}い{始|はじ}めてから、{肩|かた}こりが{楽|らく}になった。
examples.english: Since I started going to the bodywork clinic my friend recommended, my stiff shoulders have improved.

notes:
A compound of {整体|せいたい} (body adjustment/alignment) and {院|いん} (clinic/institution). {整体院|せいたいいん} are extremely common in Japan — they can be found near most train stations and in shopping areas. They are not medical facilities and do not require a medical license, unlike {接骨院|せっこついん} (bonesetting clinics) which are licensed.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整体院|せいたいいん}に{通|かよ}う: to regularly visit a bodywork clinic
- {整体院|せいたいいん}を{開業|かいぎょう}する: to open a bodywork clinic
- {整体院|せいたいいん}で{施術|せじゅつ}を{受|う}ける: to receive treatment at a bodywork clinic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {接骨院|せっこついん}: bonesetting clinic — licensed facility for treating bone and joint issues
- {鍼灸院|しんきゅういん}: acupuncture and moxibustion clinic — uses needles and heat therapy
- マッサージ{店|てん}: massage shop — focuses on muscle relaxation rather than structural alignment
